lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a structured grid of vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Light vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular high-luminance blobs to form grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear feature across the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light to shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Three remoras (commensal fish) are clearly visible in the water column below the shark's ventral-lateral margin.
